name: Battery Limiter
author: alexdont
description: Cap your battery's charge level to extend its lifespan: set the kernel charge limit (60/80/100 or a custom value) from the bar, see battery health and cycle count. Every change is a single explicit polkit prompt — no daemons, no udev rules

barWidget.description: Shows the active charge limit; click to open charge-limit controls and battery health.

schema.label: Show limit next to the icon
schema.description: Display the active charge limit (e.g. 80) beside the battery icon. Off shows just the icon; the limit is always visible in the card.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Battery draws a battery outline. Bolt draws a lightning bolt, which tells the widget apart from Omarchy's own battery indicator when both sit in the bar.
